'''Reggi Tirver''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] who worked as a [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] in [[Nym's Base]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Reggi Tirver appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
